text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Tuesday:
- Winterthur Insurance subsidiary Winterthur Europe Assurances (WEA) will merge in Belgium with local Assurances Groupe Josi SA.
- Swiss retail group Valora is taking a 76 percent stake in German railroad station newsstand chain Stilke Buch- und Zeitschriftenhandels GmbH from Douglas Holding AG in Aachen.
- Switzerland has denied Zaire's President Mobutu Sese-Seko a visa to re-enter the country. Mobutu had recently undergone cancer treatment in Lausanne and wanted to return for further treatment.
- Telecommunications group Ascom received an order from the Swiss army for radio equipment worth 490 million Swiss francs.

- The Swiss government, Swiss banks, Jewish organisations and the United States are increasing the scale and number of investigations into the fate of Jewish assets put in Swiss banks for safekeeping before and during World War Two.
